summary: Tested live Google Document AI (Form Parser, eu) and own Google OAuth, with a full regression. 4 billed Document AI calls in total: 1 API engine check, 1 API upload, 1 UI engine check, 1 UI upload. BACKEND: test_docai_live.py passes 4/4 and needed no changes. Engine check: ready, 4 ok steps, 0 pages charged, followed by a 429 cooldown. Real upload: 1 page, exactly 3 rows with the right amounts, reference 1001, reconciled, 1 page charged; history, CSV/XLSX export, edit leading to mismatch, and delete leading to 404 all work. A 16-page PDF returns 400 with no pages charged. A fake Google code returns 401. Out-of-date tests were updated so the suite reflects configured=true, and the one that sent a blank PDF to Google was removed. Full suite (excluding the live file): 67/67 pass on two runs in a row; with the live run that is 71 tests. FRONTEND (1920px, demo user): the engine card shows 'Document AI is working' with 4 ok steps (config, credentials as ledgerstream-server@ledgerstreamai.iam.gserviceaccount.com, processor 2aa6e45c564793be in eu, 3 transactions). No not-configured banner shows, and an immediate second click gives the cooldown toast. Uploading for The Burger Shack: the grid shows exactly 3 rows (09/01 Opening deposit $1,000.00 / $1,000.00; 09/02 Office supplies 1001 $150.25 / $849.75; 09/03 Client payment $420.00 / $1,269.75). The banner shows reconciled, the sidebar page counter goes from 0/5 to 1/5, and the panel shows 4 of 5 pages left. A cell edit and save works ('Changes saved', and the change is in the DB). The CSV export holds the edited row and the XLSX export (5 KB) downloads from History. Deleting from History works ('Removed from history'). Google button: it is enabled and goes to accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth with the right client_id, redirect_uri=<origin>/auth/google, response_type=code, scope 'openid email profile', state and prompt=select_account. Google then shows the expected redirect_uri_mismatch page. Regression: the Toast payout split balances at $8,522.45 and shows the variance note (file net $5,919.87 vs journal $5,965.71, -$45.84). The History variance filter shows 1 row with badge 1 and its CSV export downloads. Logout sends you to /login, /dashboard is protected, and re-login works.

minor.issue: Known flaky test: the test runner's outbound NAT IP alternates, which splits the rate-limit counter. test_forgot_rate_limit failed once in the first full run, then passed 3 times in a row. This is not an app bug.

issues: The green status label 'Document AI is working' wraps onto two lines next to the title in the 320px side card. Consider putting the status on its own line or using whitespace-nowrap.

action_items: Register <origin>/auth/google (preview and production origins) as Authorized redirect URIs in Google Cloud Console. This is a user action; until it is done Google returns redirect_uri_mismatch.

Optional: tables_to_dataframe skips any Form Parser table with no Date+Description header row. Multi-page statements whose continuation tables do not repeat the header will silently lose transactions. Consider carrying the last header mapping forward to the next table when its column count matches.

Optional: _map_columns has no mapping for a single signed 'Amount' column, which many banks use. Those statements would produce rows with no withdrawal or deposit. Consider mapping 'amount' and splitting by sign.
Optional: COLUMN_KEYWORDS maps any header containing 'check' to reference, so an amount column titled 'Checks' (or 'Checks Paid') would become a reference instead of a withdrawal.
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md if the Google redirect URI note ('registered') is not yet true.
critical_code_review_comments: lambda_function.py is about 1840 lines in one file. It should be split into modules (auth, statements/docai, payouts, billing, email).

Form Parser results never set statement_totals (they are always null). Reconciliation therefore depends only on the printed running balances, and the opening balance is back-calculated from the first row. That is fine, but statements with no balance column will always show 'unavailable'.
Deleting a statement does not refund its pages. This looks intended, but confirm the product rule.
Engine checks are billed Document AI calls. The cooldown is 30s per user only, so many accounts could each run checks. Consider a global/daily cap.
